What Road Compass can tell you

The switches above are transport preferences. They do not measure live Tor circuits, nearby peers, or whether a message arrived. Bluetooth and Wi-Fi also depend on device permissions, radio availability, and proximity. For delayed delivery, see Mailbox status. Briar stores your conversations on your device; this guide does not upload diagnostics or modify your settings.
